cohort: Parturients delivering with neuraxial analgesia in Helsinki, Finland area hospitals in 2022, including 2654 with induced labors and 5222 with spontaneous onset labors.
finding: Induction of labor was associated with a higher risk of poor maternal satisfaction on analgesia compared to spontaneous onset labor (AOR 1.19, 95% CI: 1.06-1.34).
mod_finding: During induced labor, both operative vaginal delivery (AOR=1.30; 95% CI: 1.05-1.60) and cesarean delivery (AOR=1.30; 95% CI: 1.06-1.59) were associated with worsening maternal satisfaction on analgesia.
